payout_quote: Maricopa County: selected trial jurors receive $12 per day plus mileage; jurors released on the first day without being selected receive mileage reimbursement only.
steps: Receive a Maricopa County Superior Court jury summons
If selected, receive $12/day plus mileage; if released day one, mileage only
catches: $12/day is among the lowest juror rates in the country.
Jurors not selected on day one get mileage only — no daily fee.
biggest_catch: Only $12/day, and only if you're actually selected for a trial.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in Maricopa County Superior Court, Arizona.
